svg.title: Federal Funds Matchmaker security and threat model (current state)
svg.desc: Data-flow diagram with trust boundaries, threat badges T1 to T12, control badges, and planned items shown dashed. Recommendations are not built.
svg.text: Federal Funds Matchmaker: security and threat model, current state
Team 15 | DFD with trust boundaries (STRIDE + LLM risks) | state read 2026-11-06 | draft v0.1 | public data only
Alerts only, not a hard limit
from repo history; use Key Vault
Rate limit / WAF in front of app
Show data as-of date on screen
Audit log of who decided what
Keep min 1 replica for demo only
Thick solid: runs today, crosses a boundary
Orange dashed: PLANNED flow or element
Grey dashed: not built, only suggested
Dashed ring: threat on a PLANNED item
Shapes: rectangle = outside entity; rounded = process;
open top and bottom lines = data store.
Controls verified by read-only az checks on 2026-11-06.
TLS: HTTPS ingress seen working; no custom cert.
Public URL, no login (Spoofing, Info): anyone can open it; data is public only. TODAY
api_keys.env committed in private repo: fix before any public or State handoff. TODAY
Single replica, 38 s cold start (Denial of service). TODAY
Budget is an alert, not a hard cap (cost runaway). TODAY
Image built from a laptop with az acr build; no signing or CI (Tampering). TODAY
No user identity, so no record of who did what (Repudiation). TODAY
Data is a snapshot in the image; tool.html uses qualifier data; deadlines go stale. TODAY
Blob: JS tool will read payload.json; no role or identity set up yet; least privilege. PLANNED
Prompt injection from ingested notice or plan text (OWASP LLM01). PLANNED
Data handling in prompts. Public data only; sponsor privacy question open; no-training claim [uncertain]. PLANNED
Invented quotes or wrong fit; over-reliance. Script checks quotes; human decides. PLANNED
Unbounded token use; estimate about $0.50 for a full pass [estimate]. PLANNED
